home.title: ピアノ録音をMIDIに変換
home.description: ピアノ録音を編集可能なMIDI、MusicXML、楽譜に変換します。
home.heading: ピアノ録音向けオーディオMIDI変換ツール
home.intro: Turn a piano recording into editable MIDI, MusicXML and PDF sheet music. Review the detected notes against the original audio before you export.
home.uploadBody: Use MP3, WAV or M4A. Select a 1–90 second excerpt and create an anonymous task that can be restored after refresh.
home.rights: Confirm that you have the rights needed to process the audio before uploading.
home.featureEditableBody: Get MIDI and MusicXML that can continue into a DAW or notation app, not a flattened picture.
home.featureReviewBody: Compare the source with the score and piano roll before deciding whether the result is useful.
home.featureTemporaryBody: Uploaded audio and results are kept for at most 24 hours, and the current task can be deleted immediately.
home.processHeading: From sound to notes you can keep working with.
home.processBody: The current version focuses on piano transcription. It exposes uncertainty instead of presenting every automatic result as perfect.
home.stepSelectBody: Upload a piano recording and trim 1–90 seconds on the waveform.
home.stepTranscribeBody: Generate MIDI, then build basic timing, hand assignment and score structure.
home.stepExportBody: Compare the score and piano roll, then download MIDI, MusicXML or PDF.
home.outputsHeading: Editable outputs, not a flattened preview
home.midiBody: Open the transcription in a DAW and continue editing notes, timing and velocity.
home.musicXmlBody: Move the score into compatible notation software for detailed engraving.
home.pdfBody: Keep a readable reference generated from the current transcription.
home.stepsHeading: From recording to notes in three steps
home.stepsIntro: Use the score, piano roll and playback controls to decide what needs correction. SongDance does not claim automatic output is publication-ready.
home.prepareBody: Choose an MP3, WAV or M4A file and trim a 1–90 second excerpt.
home.runBody: SongDance detects piano notes and builds editable score data.
home.reviewBody: Compare the source audio with the score and piano roll, then download the useful formats.
home.faq1Question: Can I convert any audio recording to MIDI?
home.faq1Answer: The current version is designed for piano-focused recordings. Full mixes, vocals and other instruments are not presented as supported inputs yet.
home.faq2Question: Which audio formats can I upload?
home.faq2Answer: You can upload MP3, WAV and M4A files up to 25 MB, then select a 1–90 second excerpt.
home.faq3Question: Is the generated MIDI always accurate?
home.faq3Answer: No automatic transcription is perfect. Dense chords, pedal, noise and overlapping notes can produce errors, so SongDance includes score and playback views for review.
home.faq4Question: Can I export sheet music too?
home.faq4Answer: Yes. Successful jobs can provide MusicXML for notation software and a PDF generated from the current score.
home.faq5Answer: Task data is deleted after 24 hours, and an immediate delete action is available on the task page.

privacy.metaDescription: How SongDance processes, stores and deletes anonymous audio transcription data.
privacy.title: Your audio is processed only for this transcription
privacy.summary: This policy explains what we receive, how long it is kept, which operational data is recorded and how you can delete a task immediately.
privacy.section1P1: We receive the piano audio excerpt you submit, up to 90 seconds, and generate MIDI, MusicXML, timeline data and a score preview. Tasks use random high-entropy links and do not require an account.
privacy.section1P2: Audio and transcription artifacts are used only to complete the current task. They are not used for model training or published as examples.
privacy.section2P1: Source audio, intermediate files and exports are deleted 24 hours after task creation. The task page also provides immediate deletion, which cannot be undone.
privacy.section2P2: Download links expire quickly. Object storage stays private and the browser does not receive a permanent public object address.
privacy.section3P1: The service records request IDs, irreversible task ID hashes, stage timings, model versions and error codes for reliability and troubleshooting.
privacy.section3P2: Logs and product events exclude audio content, original file names, full object keys and sensitive source URLs. Anonymous rate limiting briefly uses an encrypted IP digest.
privacy.section4P1: Do not upload content you do not have the right to process. While a task is available, you can download its artifacts or delete all task data immediately.
privacy.section4P2: SongDance is currently an anonymous MVP. It does not build user profiles or use advertising or cross-site identity tracking.

terms.metaDescription: SongDance content rights, service limits and acceptable-use terms.
terms.title: Only process content you have the right to use
terms.summary: SongDance is a limited automatic transcription tool, not an accuracy guarantee or a way to bypass content rights or platform restrictions.
terms.section1P1: You must own or hold the copyright, license or other legal right needed to upload, process and transcribe the audio. Do not submit leaked private, infringing or unlawful content.
terms.section1P2: You retain rights to the source audio. Using SongDance does not transfer ownership of the audio or musical work to us.
terms.section2P1: The current version targets piano audio excerpts up to 90 seconds. Automatic output can contain note, timing and notation errors and must be reviewed for critical production or publication.
terms.section2P2: Continuous availability is not guaranteed. Capacity, anonymous frequency and daily task counts are limited, and maintenance or dependency failures may pause new tasks.
terms.section3P1: Do not bypass rate limits, consume inference resources in bulk, probe other task links, attack the service or use artifacts to distribute malicious content.
terms.section3P2: By default, each IP can create up to three tasks per hour and run one task at a time. Follow the page guidance when capacity is reached.
terms.section4P1: Tasks and artifacts are deleted after 24 hours by default. Immediate deletion is irreversible, so save needed exports first.
terms.section4P2: The service may reject abusive or unlawful requests and remove temporary data associated with traffic that threatens system security.
